_about: Fixed list of engineering results computed for every pull request by scripts/engineering-report.mjs and compared with validation/report/reference/*.json (made by make_reference.py). Engine inputs: T in K, P in kPa, mole fractions. Quantity keys carry their display units. Tolerance classes are named in `tolerances`; `rel` is a fraction, `abs` is in the quantity's units.

boilingPointAvg.basis: Average of the measured normal boiling points on the NIST WebBook page, stated uncertainty 1 K or less (components built from measured data)

boilingPointAvgWide.basis: Report only: the WebBook average of the measured normal boiling points states an uncertainty above 1 K

boilingPointSingle.basis: Report only: the WebBook page has no averaged normal boiling point: its one value (a compilation), or the median of its values, without a stated uncertainty

boilingPointFitted.basis: Report only: the vapour-pressure record is fitted to this boiling point (no other measured vapour pressure near it), so this is a consistency check

bubbleT.basis: Chosen for this report, as for azeotrope temperatures (not in proposal 0002)

bubbleT_scatter.basis: Secondary compilation with visible scatter; same bound as test/vle.test.js

bubbleY.basis: Chosen for this report (not in proposal 0002)

excessEnthalpy.basis: Report only: these data were used in the fit (AAD 24-30 J/mol), so this is a consistency check

excessEnthalpyPredicted.basis: Report only: excess enthalpy predicted from parameters fitted to vapour-liquid data, here outside their temperature range

flashT.basis: Independent implementation (thermo FlashVL and independent enthalpies, same parameters)

lleData.basis: Model deviation from mutual-solubility data reported by the fit (AAD 0.0034 against Xu 2017); data uncertainty 0.0012

dewX.basis: Chosen for this report: the liquid at a dew point (not in proposal 0002)

bubbleP.basis: Chosen for this report: fit AAD 1.2 % with the paper's own pure-component pressures, plus the databank vapour pressures (not in proposal 0002)

steam.basis: IAPWS-IF97 against IAPWS-95: IF97 agrees with IAPWS-95 within its stated uncertainty, not to 1e-8 (team brief)

gasDensity.basis: Report only: equation of state against the reference equation of state (team brief)

eos.basis: Report only: Peng-Robinson against the reference mixture model (team brief)

groups.title: Bubble and dew points (T-x-y and P-x spot points)
